acceptance: Corpus validation rejects committed throughput bundles when len(stream_results) differs from an integer run.streams, or config.streams when run.streams is absent; absent configured counts skip the check. The error names the bundle path and both counts.

Explorer pipeline and local result import withhold Throughput@Size when the configured count differs from stream_results length; pipeline entries use stream_count_mismatch when the primary exclusion would otherwise be missing_primary_metric.
Unit tests cover matching, absent configured counts, and mismatches in run.streams/config.streams across corpus validation, the Explorer pipeline, and local Explorer import.
context: Opus review finding O1 on PR #2761 (feat/throughput-corpus-three-engines).
description: In results-data/validate_corpus.py (lines 97-101) and _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py (_stream_count), stream_count is derived solely as len(phases.throughput_test.stream_results). If a benchmark configuration specifies --streams S but fewer or more stream entries are recorded in the bundle, or if run.streams disagrees with stream_results, the discrepancy is silently masked rather than flagged as an invalid run.
